opening.argument: The presentation centers on paid OneCoin packages whose returns depend on recruitment and team volume. It says participants earn from "direct sales" and receive network and matching bonuses as their teams grow, while another explanation ties 10 percent earnings to volume in the lesser team leg. It then compares a EUR 5,030 Tycoon package with a projected EUR 24,000 token value, encouraging expectations of substantial appreciation and account doubling. The speaker closes with a direct invitation to "partner with our team today," and the description adds an urgent signup prompt. These paid entry costs, aggressive return expectations, binary team compensation, and explicit recruitment appeal show an active solicitation rather than neutral cryptocurrency education.
